Private thesis reading views, 2026-10-28

All rendering assets are self-hosted. Manuscript text, bibliography text, and
PDF bytes enter script-only opaque-origin frames after account authorization.
The frames receive no authentication SDK, token, storage grant, or network API.
Source code for the feature is available from the site operator on request.

Document parsing reuses the existing message renderer and its lockfile-pinned
markdown-it 15.0.2 (MIT), KaTeX 0.19.0 (MIT), Mermaid 12.1.0 (MIT), and
DOMPurify 3.4.16 (Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0). Original licenses accompany these files.

APA 6 bibliography formatting uses citeproc-js 2.4.63, Copyright Frank Bennett,
distributed under CPAL-1.0. Original license and complete processor source are
included as CITEPROC-LICENSE and citeproc-source.js. Bibliography data is parsed
by Citation.js core and BibTeX plugin 0.9.0 (MIT). CITATION-JS-LICENSE is included.
APA 6 CSL style, Citation Style Language project, CC BY-SA 3.0, unchanged source
apa-6th-edition.csl, commit b14d5c334934bf6c72aa164aba22d3d467988327.
English locale, CSL project, CC BY-SA 3.0, unchanged locales-en-US.xml,
commit 938c09c164a60b3cfeabe61089f1bf4c3ea6a4ed.
https://github.com/citation-style-language/styles
https://github.com/citation-style-language/locales
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/

PDF pages use Mozilla PDF.js 6.4.299, Apache-2.0, with PDFJS-LICENSE included.
Only canvas page rendering is used. PDF scripting, forms, links, annotations,
attachments, remote resources, and embedded viewers are not activated.
One page is rendered at a time with bounded dimensions. The parent removes
the frame after a 20-second timeout or account change. Large or unsupported
documents may require reading the downloaded PDF instead.
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js

The Latin Sora font comes from this site's existing self-hosted font files,
under SIL Open Font License 1.1. Existing font license remains at /fonts/.

The reading view supports Markdown prose, headings, lists, tables, bounded
equations and diagrams, and the APA 6 bibliography. It does not execute Quarto
code cells, fetch images or links, resolve citation keys, or reproduce every
Quarto extension. LaTeX is read as the compiled main.tex PDF. Utility source
files remain available in the source editor. APA formatting cannot repair
incorrect or incomplete bibliographic metadata.
